📦 **meadow-food1017 `76f4347`** — art: land fine-meal artwork on main ahead of food-3 activation

Import TASK-1017 artwork/provenance independently from the pending TASK-1016 gameplay branch. Mark food-3 as completed artwork awaiting activation in RESOURCES. Category validation accepts only explicitly declared pending art, checks its128px image and main fallback, and rejects stale pending markers after runtime activation. Commodity checks exclude declared pending category art; unknown images remain errors.

Validate on main e3cfc72:9 runtime classes/10 images/pending food-3/errors0;116 commodities/113 images/all differences empty. Twelve isolated positive/negative cases pass, including missing/wrong-size/undeclared art, unknown class, bad fallback and activation transition. Evidence docs/evidence/food1017/FOOD1017_EVIDENCE.md and pending-checks.json.

No world logic, economy settings, recipes or buildings changed. Artwork previously exhibited in ArtGallery21f69d2. TASK-1016 remains unmerged by Tim's request.

Refs TASK-1017
